stories.head: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen for rapid agent workflows
stories.fact: Google released Hydrogen across the Gemini API, AI Studio and other products. It targets rapid coding and agent workflows; Antigravity’s Orchestrator switches between models within a session.
stories.why: Benchmark task routing for MATLAB research: measure verified correctness, elapsed time and total cost against a single-model baseline.
stories.unc: Vendor benchmarks and orchestration claims do not establish reliable financial research or gains on your own workload.
labels: Hydrogen: rapid coding and agent tasks
Local gate: correctness, time and cost
stories.alt: Four conceptual labels distinguish Hydrogen execution, API access, model routing and a local correctness, time and cost benchmark.

stories.head: Battery-trading preprint tailors forecasts to order-book opportunities
stories.date: Hirsch, Schaurecker and Wozabal preprint submitted November 12, 2026, 17:43:52 UTC
stories.fact: The authors extend a rolling intrinsic battery-trading policy using distributional forecasts of an order-book-derived target. Their 2023–2024 high-frequency simulation reports profit improvements up to 42% over the naive policy.
stories.why: Test targets aligned with feasible actions and compare forecast accuracy with decision value and stability under matched risk and costs.
stories.unc: The reported maximum is simulation evidence, not live profit or an expected equity-market return; battery constraints and market design limit transfer.
stories.alt: Conceptual labels connect order-book targets to distributional forecasts and identify the authors’ up-to-42-percent simulated profit gain versus naive rolling intrinsic during 2023–2024.

stories.head: S&P futures edge higher while Nasdaq contracts remain flat
stories.fact: At 5:33 a.m. CST, Reuters reported S&P 500 futures +0.15%, Dow futures +0.05% and Nasdaq 100 futures −0.03%.
stories.why: Monitor ES/NQ relative strength and SPY/QQQ breadth separately; refresh quotes after the inflation release before sizing execution.
stories.unc: This is an earlier reported snapshot, not a live executable quote or evidence of deep liquidity.
stories.alt: Three labels compare S&P, Dow and Nasdaq futures percentage changes at the same November 13 premarket checkpoint.

stories.head: October PPI is due today at 7:30 a.m. CST
stories.date: BLS November 2026 calendar, rechecked November 13 before release
stories.fact: BLS schedules the October Producer Price Index release for November 13 at 8:30 a.m. EST / 7:30 a.m. CST / 13:30 UTC. Results were unavailable at the research cutoff.
stories.why: Separate pre-release and post-release states, stress gaps and spread expansion, and compare component readings with timestamped expectations.
stories.unc: This confirms timing only. It is neither an inflation forecast nor a Federal Reserve decision; PPI does not map one-for-one into CPI or PCE.
stories.credit: BLS November 2026 release calendar; checked November 13
stories.alt: Calendar labels show the October 2026 PPI reference month and November 13 release at 7:30 CST, with the result explicitly unknown at cutoff.

stories.head: Cisco reports 24% revenue growth and raises fiscal-year outlook
stories.date: Cisco fiscal Q1 2027 results published November 12, 2026; quarter ended October 24
stories.fact: Cisco reported quarterly revenue of $18.5 billion, up 24%, GAAP EPS of $1.14 and non-GAAP EPS of $1.40. It raised fiscal 2027 revenue guidance to $74.8–$75.8 billion.
stories.why: Track networking demand alongside margins and cash conversion; separate reported results from forward guidance when evaluating infrastructure exposure.
stories.unc: Non-GAAP earnings require reconciliation; guidance is forward-looking and does not establish future growth or share-price performance.
stories.alt: Separate labels show Cisco Q1 fiscal 2027 revenue and growth, GAAP and non-GAAP EPS, and forward fiscal-year revenue guidance without adding unlike measures.
